name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Building email programs that move people to act is my day-to-day. At Solenzo I design and run automated lifecycle journeys for consumer-facing service businesses: onboarding, reminders, nurture, reactivation of lapsed customers, and review requests, built on segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead scoring in GoHighLevel and HubSpot. I write the copy, set up the tracking, and iterate on what the numbers show.

At Level Agency I built complex email sequences and landing pages for accounts spending $20K+ a month on ads, ran A/B tests, and walked clients through ROI and conversion results. Financial services is a space I care about too: I served a banking client at Fetch & Funnel, and I'm genuinely interested in making big financial decisions like insurance easier for the people making them.
I live in Arvada, and the Denver hybrid schedule works for me. Open to a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
